queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'KNIME Analytics Platform %' AND publisher = 'KNIME AG';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'KNIME Analytics Platform %' AND publisher = 'KNIME AG' AND version_compare(version, '5.8.3') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'knime.exe');
